title: [finding] the user-visible blank-target refusal banner is pinned in ONE of its two writers — plugin-designer has no assertion on it, while app-shell docblock declares both are pinned and cannot drift
body:
Filed from objectui#8897 (dev seat, session `session_01611D6ZaRaMmwTNQmSbk8MH`), which measured this while paying that card's stated cost. ⛔ Unassigned; grading and `domain:*` are triage's.

## The claim, and the measurement that contradicts it

`packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts`, in the `assertRelationshipTargetPresent` docblock, states verbatim:

> `MetadataFieldsPage` carries the sibling copy for the same reason it carries the sibling `toFieldsMap` and `carryOver` ... **Both are pinned, and each pin asserts the same four states so the copies cannot drift.**

The second half is false for the refusal MESSAGE. Measured by ablation on the objectui#8897 branch:

1. Replace the whitespace-only branch of `describeUnusableTarget` in `packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataFieldsPage.tsx` with an obvious marker sentence. Proven on disk before running: marker present 1, original absent 0, file hash differs from its `HEAD` blob.
2. `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-designer/` from the repo root — **18 files, 142 tests, all passed.**
3. Control run, same command, unmutated tree — 18 files, 142 tests, all passed. Identical.

⇒ Nothing in `plugin-designer` reads that sentence.

## ⭐ The instrument is validated on a known positive

A zero from an instrument that cannot see the class is not a reading, so the identical ablation was run on the OTHER copy first. Replacing the same branch in `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts` turns exactly one test red:

    FAIL packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.specKeyReference.test.ts
      > objectui#7714 · the refusal message distinguishes the four states
      > whitespace-only ...
      AssertionError: expected '[MetadataService] cannot save the fie…' to match /TRIMMED value/
      Test Files 1 failed (1) · Tests 1 failed | 17 passed (18)

Same mutation shape, same runner, same invocation form — red on one copy, green on the other. The zero is a reading.

## ⚠️ This already produced a real drift, inside the card that found it

While correcting the message under objectui#8897 this seat wrote "This **page** refuses it first" in the `plugin-designer` copy and "This **writer** refuses it first" in the `app-shell` copy. Both originals said "writer". The full `plugin-designer` suite stayed green. It was caught by a hand `diff` of the two functions, not by any gate — which is the whole mechanism this card is about, demonstrated accidentally and in the smallest possible increment.

## Why it matters more than an ordinary missing pin

The sentence is **user-visible**. It is the error-banner text an author reads in the Field Designer when a relationship field is refused — the exact surface objectui#8897 was graded `Bug` for, because "the product is telling users something the artifact contradicts". objectui#8897 corrected both copies; only one of them can now be corrected wrongly and noticed.

⚠️ The asymmetry is invisible from either side alone: `app-shell`'s docblock asserts the parity, `plugin-designer` carries no counter-claim, and the `app-shell` pin is green, so every local signal reads "covered".

⛔ Note also that objectui#8897's own card text and its triage comment BOTH state that the message "is asserted verbatim by pins in **both** writers' test files". That premise is false and was carried into the dispatch as an expected cost. It is recorded here so the next reader does not inherit it.

## Two directions, not a prescription

- **Pin it** — give `MetadataFieldsPage.specKeyReference.test.tsx` the four-state message describe block its sibling already has. Cheapest; leaves the parity claim true by construction and adds one more place for the two to be edited apart.
- **Derive it** — the two copies exist because the writers convert different input types on different paths; the MESSAGE does not depend on that. A shared message builder would make drift unrepresentable rather than merely detectable. ⚠️ Costs a new cross-package dependency edge or a third home, which is presumably why the copies exist.

Either way the false half of the docblock sentence needs correcting, and a gate for the parity of the two copies' PROSE is what `scripts/check-designer-field-key-parity.mjs` does NOT do today (it judges payload shapes and keys, by name, not message text).
